subject: Adding validation on tightening_ratio and fp_rate for load (#91)
reason: The change only adds defensive (0,1) range validation for fp_rate and tightening_ratio to the bloom module's RDB-load callback (BloomObject::load_from_rdb in src/bloom/data_type.rs); on an out-of-range value it now returns None, failing the load, where the parent accepted it. Every command path that creates a bloom object already enforces the same bound unchanged by this PR -- CONFIG SET, BF.RESERVE/BF.INSERT, and BF.LOAD via decode_object's checks at utils.rs:497-504, which the diff does not touch -- so no command sequence can place an out-of-range fp_rate/tightening_ratio into the keyspace,
